annotations.title: Tell the people who make Chorus what went wrong or was missing.

description: Sends a short note to the people who make Chorus about a tool that failed or returned something unexpected, a request no tool covers, or a description that was unclear. Email addresses and phone numbers are taken out before the note is kept. It changes nothing on any book and emails nobody.

book.description: The book’s handle, when the note is about one book.

tool.description: The Chorus tool the note is about, when there is one.

trying_to.description: What the person wanted done, in a few words, for example order a second printed copy.

what_happened.description: What went wrong, what was missing or what was unclear, in a sentence or two.
